 porcelain surfaces of all transformer & wall bushings / insulators.

Clean neutral
 CT, earthing switches, check that all bolted connections are tight.

Clean contacts
 of all neutral disconnect switches, lubricate all bearing points.

Inspect the
 transformer control cabinet, check the condition of the door seal, blow out

Perform the

Check the
 condition of the silicagel breather, replace silicagel if one or more
 sections are discoloured, check for the correct oil level in bottom oil
 cup.

Check
 breakdown voltage of insulating oil (every one year).

Return
 transformer bank to normal service.

Introduction
This document lists the 
equipment Inspection checklist I1, which must be performed from one month to 3 
months as indicated by M1:3 in the title block. The first draft initiated 
by the Canadian SISP specialists. The first revision date 
06 March 2002.
Safety Precaution
Wear your safety helmet & safety belt when cleaning
 bushings / insulators.
Transformer isolation and proper earthing is required.
There is a danger of falling into the oil containment pit
 when working near large power transformers.
It is recommended to use only fiberglass(PVC) ladders when
 working in the switchyard.
Tools and Equipment
Safety helmet, safety belt, PVC
 ladders, and tool set
Work to be carried out
Clean all
 porcelain surfaces of all transformer & wall bushings / insulators.
Clean neutral
 CT, earthing switches, check that all bolted connections are tight.
Clean contacts
 of all neutral disconnect switches, lubricate all bearing points.
Inspect the
 transformer control cabinet, check the condition of the door seal, blow out
 the inside of the control cabinet with compressed air using moderate
 pressure.
Perform the
 same inspection as in step 4 on the control cabinet of the tap changer.
Check for
 signs of oil leaks.
Check oil
 levels in tank, conservator and all oil filled bushings.
Check oil
 temperature and winding temperature indicators, record maximum temperature
 indication from drag hand before resetting drag hand.
Make a visual
 inspection of all cooling fans, remove any debris from fan screens, switch
 on cooling fans manually and listen for abnormal noise.
Check the
 condition of the silicagel breather, replace silicagel if one or more
 sections are discoloured, check for the correct oil level in bottom oil
 cup.
Check
 breakdown voltage of insulating oil (every one year).
Return
 transformer bank to normal service.
